clips.title: The story
paras: Couriers arriving in Thunder Bluff can find Ahanu in Hewa's Armory. He crafts and trades leather armor for travelers and young braves setting out across Mulgore and the wider plains, and helps new couriers find their way across the bluffs.

Ahanu works the hides his friend Jahan Hawkwing sends from the Crossroads. In Hewa's Armory on Thunder Bluff's lower rise, he crafts durable leather gear for those who travel Kalimdor's grasslands. Travelers arriving by wind rider from the Crossroads can find him among the city's tradesfolk. He receives their deliveries and directs messengers toward the local flight roosts.
